Title: Lights Out!
Content: Students are learning about eyes in science class. During their class discussion, a power outage occurs and the lights go out in the classroom. While the teacher looks for a flashlight, one student exclaims, “I can't see anything!” The teacher turns on a flashlight and points it across the classroom to a plant on a table. The teacher says, “This makes me wonder how we are able to see the plant.”
